title: 贫与富的乡村旅行
paragraphs: A rich man once took his son on a trip to a village. He wanted his son to know the differences (1) their life and the villagers’ so that his son could cherish (珍爱) what he had. They spent (2) a few days with a family there.
On their way back home, the father (3) about his son’s ideas about the trip. So he asked, “(4) was the trip?”
“What did you learn from the trip?” the father couldn’t (5) to ask.

The son answered, “We have one dog, but the family has four. We have a swimming pool, but they have a big river with many (6) swimming in it. We have some expensive lights, but they have (7) stars at night. We buy vegetables in the supermarket, but they (8) vegetables in their garden for themselves. We have walls to protect us, (9) they have friends to keep them safe. Dad, thank you for (10) me how poor we are.”
The father couldn’t say anything, and he just stood there quietly.

questions.reason: 选C：between。differences between A and B是“A与B之间的差异”，A为their life，B为the villagers'，后者省略life。已有and连接两方，between恰好与之呼应；from、at、into均不能组成此处结构。
选A：quite。空后已有a few days，quite a few合起来表示好几天、相当多天。many/some不能直接叠加在a few前，more通常构成a few more days；判断时须把空格后的a few一起考虑。
选A：wondered。后文So he asked说明父亲想知道儿子对旅程的看法，wonder about意为想了解、对……感到好奇。worry about是担忧，原文没有忧虑线索；dislike和describe也不与about构成所需的询问动机。
选C：How。儿子回答It was great是在评价旅程怎么样，对应How was the trip?。When问时间，Where问地点，What问事物或内容，都不能引出这里对旅行感受的直接回答。
选A：wait。couldn't wait to ask意为迫不及待地问，符合父亲急切想知道儿子收获的情境。couldn't后用原形wait；seem、decide、try虽然可接不定式，却不能构成“迫不及待”的惯用表达。
选D：ducks。many ____ swimming in it说明大河里有许多正在游泳的动物，结合乡村景象，四项中ducks最贴切。hens是母鸡，birds泛指鸟，pigs是猪；不能只看到动物名词就忽略swimming和river的具体线索。
选D：lots of。stars为复数可数名词，lots of stars表示很多星星，与自家几盏昂贵的灯形成对照。a little修饰不可数名词；a lot须加of才能直接修饰stars；few虽可修饰复数，但“很少星星”不合此处突出乡村丰富资源的对比。
选B：grow。前半句说我们去超市买菜，but后相对的是村民在自家园中“种菜”，grow vegetables与in their garden、for themselves共同对应。order是订购，sell是出售，serve是供应，均不能体现自给自足。
选C：but。“我们靠墙保护自己”与“他们靠朋友保障安全”是两种生活方式的对照，用but。它们不是前因后果，也非假设条件，因此不选so、because或if；前文多组We have … but they have …也提供了结构线索。
选B：showing。thank you for doing sth表示感谢对方做了某事，for是介词，后接动名词showing。me是show的宾语，how poor we are是所展示的内容；show/shows/showed是谓语形式，均不能直接跟在此处for后。
